Sample size calculator for clinical study designs (legacy API)

Source: R/sample_size_calculator.R
sample_size_calculator.Rd

Computes sample size (or events) for two-group or single-group designs: continuous outcomes, proportions, survival (log-rank), diagnostic accuracy, case-control, AUC comparisons, non-inferiority/superiority/equivalence. Uses parameter validation and unified S3 result objects.

Usage

sample_size_calculator(
  design = c("twoMeans", "twoProportions", "pairedMeans", "survival",
    "nonInferiorityMeans", "superiorityMeans", "equivalenceMeans",
    "diagnosticAccuracySingle", "caseControl", "superiorityProportions",
    "diagnosticSuperioritySingle", "diagnosticComparisonTwo", "likelihoodRatioTest",
    "auc_single", "aucSuperiority", "aucComparison", "equivalenceProportions"),
  alpha = 0.05,
  power = 0.8,
  ...
)

sampleSizeCalculator(design, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8, ...)

Arguments

design

Study design type (see list in usage).

alpha

Type I error (default 0.05).

power

Target power (default 0.8).

...

Design-specific arguments (e.g. mean1, mean2, sd for twoMeans).

Value

Object of class sample_size_result with print, summary, plot methods.

Details

sample_size_calculator() is the legacy single-keyword API retained for backward compatibility. New code should prefer the three-axis calculate() entry point; see docs/DESIGN_MATRIX.md for the keyword mapping. Results are identical between the two entry points.

Functions

  • sampleSizeCalculator(): Deprecated alias; use sample_size_calculator.

Examples

sample_size_calculator("twoMeans", mean1 = 10, mean2 = 12, sd = 3)
#> ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results
#> • Design type: "Two independent samples, mean comparison"
#> • Sample size per group: 37
#> • Total sample size: 74
#> ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sample_size_calculator("survival", hr = 0.7, alpha = 0.05, power = 0.8)
#> ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#> ✔ Sample Size Calculation Results
#> • Design type: "Survival (log-rank)"
#> • Events needed: 247
#> ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
